summary: Allow faster upstream polling for isolated regtest simulations
details: The optional usdb.upstream_poll_interval_ms setting accepts 100 through 60000 milliseconds; existing configurations keep the five-second idle indexer poll and one-second status poll.
World-sim uses 200ms Ord and indexer polling, retaining the network stable lag and all readiness checks.
Regtest reorgs replay disconnected transactions at their original heights and complete Ord convergence after exact-height assertions.
